title.en: Lettuce with no soil, no sun

A2.text: Picture lettuce growing in a warehouse with no windows and no sun. Pink lights shine on it all day. Is this still really farming?
A2.authored_by: Claude (English teacher role); Gemini 3.1 Pro draft unavailable (API quota exhausted), authored directly
